name: Media Card
summary: A horizontal card that pairs a thumbnail with author, duration, and progress.
description: A horizontal card for one piece of video: a thumbnail on one side, and who made it and how long it runs on the other. Its height isn't set directly, it follows the thumbnail's own aspect ratio, so a wider or narrower container changes the card's height along with it.
whenToUse: Listing a video someone can play, with who made it and how long it runs
Showing playback progress on a video that's already partly watched
whenNotToUse: Showing a still photo with no video behind it — use a Changelog Row or a plain image instead
Playing the video inline on the card itself — this only starts playback elsewhere
dos: Give it a real image or thumbnail. An unset thumbnail leaves it blank.
Keep the author and duration text short enough to sit on one line.
donts: Don't rely on this card's own height. Its height follows its width instead.
Don't expect a card click to start playback. Wire the play control.

notes: The thumbnail image carries no description of its own — the author and duration text next to it carries the meaning.
The play control has its own accessible name — don't add a second one on the card around it.
